patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section with large, layered typography on the left and a smaller, descriptive text block on the right, creating a dynamic visual balance.
Dramatic contrast between oversized, decorative serif headings (some words in accent color) and clean, legible sans-serif body text and labels.
Rich, dark charcoal background serves as a canvas for warm, earthy accent colors (burnt orange, golden yellow) and light cream text, creating a sophisticated yet inviting palette.
The hero text scrolls up and out of view, while a collage of images (beer glasses and album art) animates into the viewport with subtle rotation and staggered entry as the user scrolls down.

The 'pairings' list is presented as a two-column grid with each entry having a distinct background color (alternating between orange and yellow tones) and a subtle vertical separator, resembling a curated playlist or menu.

technique_notes: The hero section uses large, layered typography where individual words or phrases are styled with different fonts and colors to create visual hierarchy and impact.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely powered by locomotive-scroll, are used to reveal content sections. Elements like the image collage appear with dynamic motion, including rotation and sliding, as they enter the viewport.
A sticky navigation bar remains fixed at the top right, maintaining its transparent background to blend seamlessly with the dark page content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold serif headings (~4-5x body text) with a mix of uppercase and title case, contrasted with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, with most elements having sharp corners, but some interactive elements like buttons and the 'READ MANIFESTO' circle feature a slight curve or pill shape.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, particularly in the hero section, with comfortable padding around content blocks and a more dense but well-structured layout for the 'pairings' list.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large, layered serif typography in the hero, combined with a rich, dark color palette and dynamic, rotating image collage, creates a sophisticated yet playful editorial feel. The unique presentation of the 'pairings' list as a visually distinct, color-coded grid further sets it apart from typical content displays.
